name: codezzn-server-bridge
description: Open the Codezzn Windows CLI or explicitly send an editor selection to your server sandbox. No local agent execution.

commands.title: Codezzn: Review Selected Code on Server

codezzn.server.description: Server origin. Only user/machine settings are read, never repository settings.

codezzn.allowInsecureHttp.description: Explicitly allow non-loopback HTTP (LAN development only).

codezzn.nodeExecutable.description: Absolute node.exe path; defaults to Program Files/nodejs/node.exe.

codezzn.cliScript.description: Absolute Codezzn bin/codezzn.js path; defaults to the user-global npm installation.
